brainstormingComments.title: Comments
brainstormingComments.follow_help: Following notifies you of new messages. Direct replies and mentions can notify you even when you are not following.
brainstormingComments.stale: This conversation changed. Review the latest state and try again.
brainstormingComments.unavailable: This conversation or its source is no longer available.
brainstormingComments.placeholder: Explain your idea or ask a question…
brainstormingComments.send_failed: Could not confirm delivery. Your text is kept in this tab; retry to check and send it.
brainstormingComments.update_failed: Could not update the thread. Please try again.
brainstormingComments.canvas_unavailable: This session is no longer available.
brainstormingComments.resolved_hint: This thread is resolved. Reopen it to continue the conversation.
brainstormingComments.empty_hint: Start a discussion below. Comments are visible to people who can read this source.
brainstormingComments.readonly_hint: You can read discussions. Editing access is required to comment.
